mapper.select: SELECT a.attachment_id AS attachmentId, a.post_id AS postId, a.uploader_id AS uploaderId, a.file_url AS fileUrl, a.file_name AS fileName, a.file_type AS fileType, a.usage_type AS usageType, a.file_size AS fileSize, a.state AS state, p.state AS postState, p.board_id AS boardId FROM attachments a LEFT JOIN posts p ON a.post_id = p.post_id WHERE a.attachment_id = #{fileId}
